words.title: Dublin ranked 6th among world’s largest cities but scores poorly for quality of life
words.body:
Dublin has been ranked the sixth-best city in the world overall, according to the 2026 Global Cities Index from Oxford Economics.

The capital ranked 6th out of 1,000 cities worldwide, behind New York, London, Paris, Seattle and San Francisco.
